plan.notes: Official 2024-2025 BCCC catalog program page ("Program: Business Administration Transfer, AS", printed Program Total 60). Accredited by the Association of Collegiate Business Schools and Programs (ACBSP). Designed for students who plan to transfer to a bachelor's degree in Business Administration (accounting, advertising, banking and finance, economics, human resources management, marketing, management, real estate). 0-credit Computer Literacy requirement documented here only. BCCC's 2025-2026 catalog program pages were unreachable via research tools (Academic Programs index requires JS; search/sitemap endpoints 403), so 2024-2025 remains the latest machine-readable official catalog.
